Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pets

Class PetsRest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.RestServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.BasicRestServlet
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.PetstoreConsolePage
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pets.PetsRest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable, BasicUniversalConfig, DefaultConfig, DefaultHtmlConfig
public class PetsRest extends PetstoreConsolePage
The pets JSON endpoints (server-mode datatable query over BeanQuery, create/replace/delete, sell, stage, and the per-pet feeds), the Pets and Sold pages, the add/edit dialog form, and the P4 pet pages: Summary (inline edit), Photo, Orders (with a row detail, and one order selected at nav depth 4) and History, whose nav nodes the page appends under pets as p<petId> and o<orderId>. The Pending changes page is the ChangesRest child.
Example:

// The BQ#6 endpoint behind the table. @RestPost(path="/query") public DataTablesResults<Pet> query(@Content DataTablesRequest req) { try (var s = store().queryPets()) { return DataTablesQuery.run(req, s); } }

<@card type="datatables" id="pets"> { dataMode:'server', dataUrl:'/console/pets/query', columns:[{key:'name', label:'Name'}, ...] } </@card>

// The same table in the builder twin. TableSpec.create("pets").dataMode(DataMode.SERVER).dataUrl("/console/pets/query") .columns(Column.create("name").label("Name"));

    • query

      public DataTablesResults<Pet> query(@Content DataTablesRequest req, @Query("ids") @Schema(aev=true) String ids)
      Server-mode DataTables query over all pets.

      The optional ids query parameter (comma-separated pet ids, as the ids URL-state directive sends it) narrows the pets to those ids, before the request's own column filters apply, so the two combine. Tokens that are not numbers are dropped, and a blank value or one with no usable token is ignored.

      Parameters:
      req - The DataTables request.
      ids - The ids to keep, or null.
      Returns:
      One page of pets, or a 200 error envelope for a malformed search expression.

    • stage

      public ActionResult stage(RestRequest req, @Path("id") long id, @Content JsonMap body)
      Stages an inline edit for review on the Pending changes page. The pet itself is not changed until the change is applied.

      PendingChanges.stage(long, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) owns which fields are stageable and its messages. The photo is deliberately not stageable: the pet detail Photo tab edits it directly through the API's own PUT /petstore/pets/{id}/photo.

      Parameters:
      req - The request.
      id - The pet id.
      body - {field, value}, or the inline-edit envelope {fields:{<field>:value}} with exactly one field.
      Returns:
      success carrying the new PendingChange.
      Throws:
      BadRequest - If the field is missing or not stageable, or the value is invalid.
      NotFound - If the pet does not exist.
